feedback.problem:
In **ascending order,** the $x$-coordinates of the points where the hyperbola $2{y}^{2}-25{x}^{2}=625$ intersects the line $y=-5x$ are

$\,x=$
{{field-1}}$\,$ and $\,x=$
{{field-2}}.
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the points where the hyperbola intersects the line $y=-5x,$ we first replace $y$ with $-5x$ in the equation of the hyperbola and solve for $x,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}2{y}^{2}-25{x}^{2} & =625 \\ 2(-5x)^{2}-25{x}^{2} & =625 \\ 2(25{x}^{2})-25{x}^{2} & =625 \\ 50{x}^{2}-25{x}^{2} & =625 \\ 25{x}^{2} & =625 \\ {x}^{2} & =25 \\ x & =\pm 5\end{aligned}
$$

So, in ascending order, the $x$-coordinates of the points of intersection are
$x=-5$ and $x=5.$
